artifact_snapshot: historical evaluated BGE-era inputs; use data/release-artifacts-v2.json for current release identities

methods.label: Classic keyword overlap
methods.strengths: Tiny logic surface; transparent; strong when the remembered words are exact.
methods.weaknesses: No phrase model, morphology, translation bridge, graph, or meaning-only recall.

methods.label: Indexed lexical core
methods.strengths: Fast compact BM25-style postings; excellent near-quotes; deterministic offline behavior.
methods.weaknesses: Weak on zero-overlap paraphrases, named concepts, and translation-specific wording.

methods.label: Lexical + expansion
methods.strengths: Portable weighted vocabulary expansion improves wrong-word and partial semantic recall.
methods.weaknesses: Synonym neighborhoods add noise; cannot reliably ground events or deep paraphrases.

methods.label: Lexical + translation/knowledge
methods.strengths: Best direct handling of KJV drift, source-backed entities/events, corrections, and passage windows.
methods.weaknesses: Sparse graph evidence does not solve general meaning similarity; source/licensing burden.

methods.label: Lexical + expansion + knowledge
methods.strengths: Broad offline recall without an encoder; strong quotes, translation drift, and named concepts.
methods.weaknesses: Semantic tail remains shallow and one hard-negative ordering failure remains in this suite.

methods.label: Dense + lexical guard
methods.strengths: Generic zero/low-overlap meaning retrieval without passage-specific rewrite rules.
methods.weaknesses: Needs an exact query encoder contract; alone it misses translation and graph advantages.

methods.label: Mode-gated full fusion
methods.strengths: Only configuration here meeting every aggregate release bar, including semantic tail and safety.
methods.weaknesses: Largest payload and memory budget; dense fusion lowers R@1 versus the no-vector hybrid; conflations remain weak.
